inputs.name: hand over from Model Evaluation Harness to Model Registry

output.level_0: The Model Evaluation Harness fails to find a Model Registry to hand over to.
output.level_1: The Model Evaluation Harness has no connection to a Model Registry.
output.level_2: The Model Evaluation Harness outputs a text file with model details for manual Model Registry upload.
output.level_3: The Model Evaluation Harness automatically uploads the model to the Model Registry.
output.level_4: The Model Evaluation Harness automatically uploads the model to the Model Registry with approval workflow.
